## Mission-Ready ISR for Australia's Unique Operating Environment


Australia presents a distinct set of challenges for intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) operators. Vast distances, remote operating locations, extensive coastlines and critical infrastructure spread across sparsely populated regions place unique demands on airborne units. Success depends on more than simply collecting imagery or getting eyes on a target. It requires reliable situational awareness, persistent observation and the ability to deliver actionable and timely information to operators across the spectrum.

As air units continue to invest in highly advanced ISR capabilities, proven sensor technology remains a critical component of effectiveness. In Australia, L3Harris partner SYPAQ excels in next-generation integration of multi-mission electro-optical/infrared sensor systems with the leading platforms in Australia’s ISR air units. The integration of the WESCAM® MX®-10 imaging and targeting system into SYPAQ's light fixed-wing surveillance fleet reflects a commitment to delivering responsive, mission-focused ISR capability for a wide range of operational requirements.


Purpose-built for size and weight, and amenable to an aircraft’s power requirements, the MX-10 provides advanced EO/IR imaging that enables crews to detect, identify and track objects of interest across increasingly complex environments. Whether supporting land surveillance, infrastructure monitoring, security operations or emergency search and rescue efforts, operators benefit from the ability to quickly transition from broad-area observation to detailed target assessment without sacrificing image quality or mission efficiency.


For Australian operators, flexibility is often just as important as sensor performance. Missions can range from monitoring remote transportation corridors and energy infrastructure to supporting border security, disaster response and public safety operations. These activities frequently involve long transit distances, demanding and ever-changing environmental conditions and the need to sustain surveillance over large areas. The MX-10's compact design and advanced imaging capabilities help maximize aircraft endurance while providing the situational awareness needed to support informed decision-making throughout the mission.


Equally important is the ability to keep aircraft and crews mission ready. WESCAM MX-Series EO/IR systems are backed by decades of operational experience supporting customers around the world, with a focus on reliability, training, technical support and lifecycle sustainment. This commitment helps operators maintain readiness and confidence in their equipment while reducing the burden associated with long-term capability management. These capabilities are enhanced through regional experts like SYPAQ who enhance the adaptation to the Australian mission.


Technology delivers the greatest value when it enhances the effectiveness of the people who use it. Combining experienced aircrews, mission operators and proven WESCAM MX-Series technology creates a capability that supports improved situational awareness, faster decisions and greater operational effectiveness. As Australia's ISR requirements continue to evolve, mission-proven WESCAM MX-Series systems remain focused on one objective: helping operators succeed, wherever the mission leads.


## Related Capabilities


WESCAM® MX®-10, Air Surveillance and Reconnaissance


A small, capable and affordable commercial sensor system ideal for low-altitude tactical surveillance and reconnaissance missions from manned and unmanned airborne platforms.


WESCAM® MX®-Series


L3Harris’ series of multi-sensor, multi-spectral, electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) surveillance and targeting systems support intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance and target acquisition missions across the air, land and sea.
